meta.title: Template Management & Versioning: refused for a user without the Tenant Admin role
gaps: Sign in as a non-Tenant Admin and a Tenant Admin on the same Enterprise tenant
Open Template Management & Versioning and attempt template versioning and UAT-to-PROD promotion
Compare refusal or absence for the non-Tenant Admin with availability for the Tenant Admin
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a non-Tenant Admin and a Tenant Admin on the same Enterprise tenant; Open Template Management & Versioning and attempt template versioning and UAT-to-PROD promotion; Compare refusal or absence for the non-Tenant Admin with availability for the Tenant Admin

args.need: On the same Enterprise tenant, sign in as a user without the Tenant Admin role and verify that Template Management & Versioning, including UAT-to-PROD promotion, is refused or absent; then repeat as a Tenant Admin and verify the action is available

steps.note: No catalog step can access the Template Management & Versioning workflow or switch between these role-specific personas.
Checks that the browser remains usable after the tester completes the unavailable role-based workflow, but does not assert the RBAC outcome.
